title: Innovation is Coming!
subtitle: Updates on what I'm up to, other than this newsletter.
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily health-themed newsletter. Owen Scott Muir, M.D., DFAACAP, is the editor here… and the author of this article. He’s a psychiatrist and an enthusiast for the future to be better. I think that will take technology and better contracts; as a summary, I don’t just write about it! For example, research is ongoing:

  1. We are currently enrolling for the SAINT Open Label Optimization Trial for Major Depressive Disorder at Fermata in Brooklyn, NY (there is a cost to participate).

  2. We are currently enrolling for an Investigational Trial using the Brainsway H1 coil for Treatment-Resistant Major Depressive Disorder at Fermata (there is no cost to participate).

  3. We will soon enroll subjects in a vocal biomarker trial to evaluate responses to rapid-acting mental health treatments (study sponsor: Psyrin). This trial will enroll in Brooklyn and Sunnyvale.

  4. In a very exciting turn of events, the TDscreen tool (created in collaboration with iRxReminder) is now available from Videra Health. This tool allows for more rapid and reliable screening for Tardive Dyskinesia!

  5. At Acacia Clinics in Sunnyvale, California, we are also enrolling for a study evaluating the use of the Sanmai tFUS device in Generalized Anxiety Disorder.

Yes, that is a lot of innovation. Thank you for noticing.

The other colossal developments?

  • Fermata is in-network with TRICARE for our active-duty military and their families.

  • This is in addition to our in-network status with Cigna for remarkable (and medication-free) treatments.

  • If you live near Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, our partners at Living Water Clinics are also bringing neuromodulation to your community:

And, of course, some publications have hit in the recent past…such as…

Solomon, T. M., Hajduk, M., Majernik, M., Jemison, J., Deschamps, A., Scoggins, J., Kolar, A., Pinheiro, M. A., Dubec, P., Skala, O., Muir, O., Tinkelman, A., Karlin, D. R., & Barrow, R. (2023). Evaluating passive physiological data collection during Spravato treatment. Frontiers in Digital Health, 5, 1281529. https://doi.org/10.3389/fdgth.2023.1281529

and…

Roth, Y., Hanlon, C. A., Pell, G., Zibman, S., Harmelech, T., Muir, O. S., MacMillan, C., Prestley, T., Purselle, D. C., Knightly, T., & Tendler, A. (2023). Real-world efficacy and safety of various accelerated deep TMS protocols for major depression. Psychiatry Research, 328, 115482. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.psychres.2023.115482

and…

Tendler, A., Goerigk, S., Zibman, S., Ouaknine, S., Harmelech, T., Pell, G. S., Zangen, A., Harvey, S. A., Grammer, G., Stehberg, J., Adefolarin, O., Muir, O., MacMillan, C., Ghelber, D., Duffy, W., Mania, I., Faruqui, Z., Munasifi, F., Antin, T., . . . Roth, Y. (2023). Deep TMS H1 Coil treatment for depression: Results from a large post marketing data analysis. Psychiatry Research, 324, 115179. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.psychres.2023.115179

and, of course, the whole series on how to think about psychedelic medicines for a primary care audience as published in the American Journal of Theraputics, starting with a historical overview:

Tabaac, Burton J. MD, FAHA1,2; Shinozuka, Kenneth BA3,4,*; Arenas, Alejandro MD5; Beutler, Bryce D. MD6; Cherian, Kirsten PhD7; Evans, Viviana D. BA8; Fasano, Chelsey BA9; Muir, Owen S. MD, DFAACAP 10,11. Psychedelic Therapy: A Primer for Primary Care Clinicians—Historical Perspective and Overview. American Journal of Therapeutics 31(2):p e97-e103, March/April 2024. | DOI: 10.1097/MJT.0000000000001727

A science tab on the newsletter’s webpage will take you to those publications and more as they hit Google Scholar!

Thanks for reading, and if people are looking for clinical trials for depression or anxiety, please feel free to reach out!
